column1: # The checks of shell/dropped-password.nsh. See check-shell-log.sh.
# The PASSWORD of a form set that uefisettings ignores could name any variable, so get,
# list-questions, show-ifr and set read and write none, even with --i-am-fine-to-brick-this-system

column3: .error_message | startswith("PASSWORD questions of package list 8C78A505-BAA0-4C4A-869F-000000000F00 may be in the IFR that uefisettings ignores at offset 114 of a form package: the FormSet 8C78A505-BAA0-4C4A-869F-000000000F01, which holds, outside its forms, an op shorter than its minimum, which UEFI 2.11 ") and endswith("; as the variable of that password is unknown, the UEFI Shell build reads and writes no variable of this HiiDB")
